notes: Independent R2 reading. Whole image viewed once for layout, then supplied a and b halves once in that order. Sixteen one-per-locus enhanced crops were viewed; no whole or half was reopened, and no locus was cropped twice. No OCR, external source, other page, other reader file, or compilation was used.
Original dimensions are 1679 by 2361 pixels. Half a is [0,0,1679,1260]; half b is [0,1100,1679,2361]. There is no H_drawings directory in this packet.

The page continues items c) and d), then has the internal heading Quelques groupes classiques sur un corps k. It discusses classical-group sequences and structures of vector, affine, torsor, and projective type. No date is written.
The author’s explicit question mark follows the A4/Aff(1,F4) line. The assertion ne splitte pas en général is a manuscript assertion, not an editorial conclusion.
The top group identifications were read from ink but were not proved or independently checked as isomorphisms. The subscripts 4 and 5 and the field subscripts 2,3,4,5 are preserved.

The first Aff expression lacks a separately written opening parenthesis. The affine datum’s Aff denominator remains doubtful on the same delimiter question. The small projective quotient retains the unmatched large opening parenthesis and an uncertain small closing curve.
The affine prose names E but its Isom quotient has V. SA01-K75-02 is explicitly confirmed as this written mismatch; the proposed E correction is not incorporated.
The projective prose says dim n while the source expression has P^{n-1}(k). The written indices are retained. The extra closing brackets in the torsor/affine discussion are also preserved.

The original C doubts are mapped by IDs C01 through C14 in their exact order. C04 and C07 resolve; the other twelve remain. C10 gains delta x as an alternative, and C13 narrows its small enclosure alternatives to (0) versus unmatched (0. Seven new doubts have IDs N01 through N07.
The foliation 13 is an archive addition in an unnamed hand and is represented only by a comment. H’s page marker is editorial and is not counted as a discrepancy.

Typographic equivalents such as H’s declared bold number fields and C’s blackboard alphabets are not counted as differences. A retained primary H reading is not called different merely because R2 keeps a doubt mark.
Visual layout and TeX brace/environment checks are transcription checks, not mathematical checks. No LaTeX compilation was performed.
